text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every race in the Classic Triple Crown only happens once in a lifetime.
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if the odds are against you,
you have to shoulder that and fight on.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Rain... No way...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"It's quite slippery.
Trainer, at this rate, the racetrack will also be..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Narita Top Road has a large stride,
bad track conditions inevitably cause her feet to slip, putting her at a disadvantage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Still, I'm sure the other Umamusume each have their own... unexpected struggles to deal with."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... The rice... has no taste...
I can't swallow it...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Even though... this is only the beginning...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then—the real thing.
The curtain rises on the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown: the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san.
It's finally here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I have done everything I can to prepare.
I look forward to working with you."
choice_data_list: Go easy on me, Admire Vega.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Go easy on you—?
Out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I will simply—win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Neither pleasantries nor jokes will get through. Part of it is her original nature, but it also shows just how major of a showdown this is.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ayabe-san, you're looking a bit pale...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Could the conditioning be off...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. Things didn't go as planned.
However..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Getting too high-strung and losing my composure—I brought that entirely on myself.
Pretty laughable, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
“—No!
Laughing is out of the question!”

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I think it's truly amazing
how serious you are, Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I respect you even more now!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I see. How curious of you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One troubled by bad track conditions, the other under the weather.
The atmosphere was heavy. And then—

Well, well, Top Road-san, Ayabe-san.
How are you feeling today?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You are...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Opera O-chan...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it really is me. Man, I'm just glad
I managed to make the last flight somehow.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
After all, we can't just leave
the grand stage entirely to the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I see... If you just came wandering by for fun,
then that's perfect timing.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hm, what do you mean by... just right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown is a festival, isn't it?
It's always better to have someone around to hype it up.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's always better to have a clown around, you know.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, so you're saying that you too
have been eagerly awaiting me?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, splendid.
Then let the three of us enjoy it together.
Come, Top Road-san, you as well!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three of them continued through the underground passage.
A long, long passage. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*sploosh!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I heard a familiar sound.
This is... water droplets.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is water seeping into the tunnel
due to the rainfall? No...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*sploosh!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The color of the drops trailing along the ground
—was red.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Which means... blood. Did Narita Top Road
get injured again?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No, if that were true, they would have reported it to me.
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Whose blood is this...?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Go for it, Class Rep Top Road!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Do your best, Narita Top Road!
I'm rooting for your wholehearted running!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, Top Road-san is quite popular.
It seems her wonderful character is becoming known
even outside Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Everyone around me has a proven track record. Meanwhile, I've forced my way here through sheer momentum. The difference is clear.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"However, the curtain waits for no one.
How could I ever bring myself to merely remain a spectator?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—A clown. Of course I shall entertain.
However, the manner of entertainment...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—I will decide.
I'd prefer not to be underestimated...
Not this Overlord.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The crimson carpet T.M. Opera O laid out.
It stretched far into the distance,
with no end in sight...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Race 1, where everyone carries a handicap.
Its outcome—now rests in the hands of three.
